title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Lesson 42 ]

items.text: Lend this money to whomever you trust.
It is he who is to blame.
I don't care what you think.
May I ask what this is about?
Could you tell me what the regular fare is between Los Angeles and New York?
Whose finger was on the button almost defined electoral success.
Compare what you have done with what you have seen.
Why this is a problem was dramatically illustrated when keynoter Susan was ousted as a former marijuana user.
The question is who will reach there first.
It is a mystery to me how they can live together when they no longer love each other.
There are various problems the solution of which is hopeless.
Is this the man of whom you spoke yesterday?
